types.label: value.title
types.note: A machine is DECOMPOSED like a canvas board or doc: this identity fact holds only {title, entry, kind?, context?}. Its nodes are `machine-node` facts and its rails are `machine-rail` facts, all nested under `machine/<name>/` (list/delete a whole machine by that prefix). The rail facts' keyEdges project node→node graph edges, so neighbors/$graph/canvas render the machine without it carrying an embedded graph.

schema.title: string
schema.context: string[]? — substrate keys a decision should read

types.label: value.name
types.note: One node of a machine, keyed `machine/<machine>/node/<name>`. The key-encoded rule projects a `node inMachine machine/<machine>` membership edge.

types.label: value.mode
types.note: An executable transition (rail) between two nodes, keyed `machine/<machine>/rail/<from>~<to>`. A CONTENT-BEARING edge: it carries the execution semantics (mode/condition/prompt/…) as fact fields, and its key-encoded rule (ADR-0003/0016) projects a node —rail→ node graph edge — the substrate's answer to 'edges with attributes' (first-class edges hold only rel+strength). This is ADR-0003 step 4 realised. `when` is the TRIGGER (docs/machine.md §8, borrowed from Agent Skills): the Level-1 'when to use this branch' descriptor a decider sees without the rail's full `prompt` body. Declaring it as `trigger` (ADR-0094 Inc 2) makes it lead the embedded text too, so a rail is retrievable by the SITUATION it handles and not only readable once you are already standing at its decision node.

schema.mode: 'auto' (deterministic, no LLM) | 'agent' (model picks a branch) | 'task' (claimable hand-off) | 'work' (spawns an agent) | 'section' (fan-out independent branches → synthesise) | 'vote' (sample one branch N× → consensus)
schema.condition: string? — CEL guard on an auto rail (over the run value)
schema.when: string? — Level-1 'when to use this branch' descriptor
schema.prompt: string? — the brief a work rail's spawned agent runs
schema.sections: section[]? — [{to, when?}] for a section rail
schema.branch: string? — the sampled node for a vote rail

types.label: value.node
types.note: A run instance, keyed `machine/<machine>/run/<run>` (children `…§<branch>` / `…#<i>`). Its `trace` records the ordered node path the stepper walked — how the run executed.

schema.via: string? — the transition that produced this state
schema.at: string? — ISO time of the last transition
